summary: Iteration 10 (colour-coded audit categories) tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (4 new Categories tests + original 14 regression tests). Frontend Playwright covers legend, legacy-char colour mapping on 2025, mark/clear/persist via popover, add Customer Audit (CUST) with green colour, mark cell w/ new category and persist, edit INT colour, delete CUST and re-verify popover shrinks to 2 options, Print/PDF HTML produces bg colours + <span class='lbl'> + .legend block + QMSF 28 doc-control footer. One real UI bug found: after deleting a category, cells that referenced it render the RAW stored id (e.g. 'tmp-1782170693975') as text, NOT blank — contradicting the spec note 'resolveCell returns null'. Same fallback path in Print HTML.

ui_bugs.issue: When resolveCell() returns null (unknown/orphaned id, e.g. after deleting the category), the cell falls back to displaying the raw stored value as text. Spec mandates the cell should appear blank. Repro: add a new category, mark a cell with it, save, delete the category, save categories — the cell now shows the raw uuid/tmp- id instead of being blank.
Same fallback in handlePrint() — `return '${esc(raw)}'` prints the raw orphan id. Should also render blank.

Newly-added category uses tmp-${Date.now()} as the id and the backend stores it verbatim (`c.id or str(uuid.uuid4())`). This makes orphan ids predictable but also non-uuid. Either filter ids starting with 'tmp-' on the backend or normalise on the frontend before save.

issues: /api/settings/ is requested over http:// causing Mixed Content errors on every page (already flagged in iter 9, unrelated to this feature).

action_items: FIX: in AuditSchedule.js cell render (line ~610), change `{cat ? (cat.short || '') : (raw || '')}` to `{cat ? (cat.short || '') : ''}` so orphan ids appear blank per spec.
FIX: in handlePrint() unmatched branch, return `` instead of echoing raw.
OPTIONAL: backend `replace_categories` could replace ids matching /^tmp-/ with a fresh uuid for cleanliness.
PRE-EXISTING: settings service requests http:// — causes Mixed Content noise.
critical_code_review_comments: resolveCell legacy_chars matcher is case-sensitive then case-insensitive — works correctly for 'C' and 'X' demo data.
Popover positions via getBoundingClientRect with viewport clamps — good.
Print HTML uses -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact and inline bg/colour — should preserve colours on print.
Default categories seeded only when collection is empty — _ensure_categories_seeded is idempotent.
PUT /categories wipes & reinserts; safe because cells store ids and orphan ids gracefully degrade (apart from the UI fallback bug above).
ScheduleUpdate PUT response now includes embedded `categories` — saves one round-trip.
seed_data_creation: Cleanup performed by tests: pre/post DELETE of 2099 and 2098. Categories restored to defaults (INT #2563eb, COMPASS #dc2626) at end. Customer Audit deleted at end. 2025 row1-mar still holds an orphan tmp- id in DB (resolveCell falls back; user can clear via popover). Recommend running `db.audit_schedules.update_one({year:2025},{$set:{'elements.1.cells.mar':''}})` if a fully-clean visual is required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new category APIs work. Frontend bug: orphan/unknown cell values render as raw text instead of blank. Single-line fix in AuditSchedule.js cell render and handlePrint(). After fix, re-run the full Playwright flow including 'delete Customer Audit and verify referenced cell becomes blank' to confirm. Backend tests are stable and auto-clean. /api/settings/ Mixed Content pollution remains pre-existing.
rca of the issue: AuditSchedule.js line ~610 renders `cat ? (cat.short||'') : (raw||'')`. When resolveCell returns null because the stored uuid/tmp-id no longer matches any category, the JSX falls through to `raw` (the orphan id string) and prints it. Should render '' to match the spec ('cells … now appear blank'). Same pattern exists in the print HTML builder.
